subject: Quick recap: pilot scope, compliance asks, and exec signoff path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novahealth.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Quick recap: pilot scope, compliance asks, and exec signoff path

Hi Elena and Carlos,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciated the candid rundown of priorities. Below is a short recap so we have shared expectations and a clear next steps/owners list. I also attached a one‑page Mutual Action Plan (MPA_v1) for the pilot.

Key pain and goals (as you described)
- Current triage latency on patient-facing Q&A is ~7–9s per request; goal is 400–600ms perceived latency for UI flows.
- Need a deterministic data boundary: no PHI persisted outside your VPC during the pilot.
- Cost predictability for the first 90 days (cap on tokens + reporting) to keep ops comfortable.

Proposed pilot scope (what Redwood will deliver)
- 4-week technical pilot: integration with one representative app, redaction-in-flight, and evaluation on 3 prompt sets.
- SLA targets during pilot: 95th p50 < 600ms for typical prompts; continuous batching disabled for first week to validate latency.

Stakeholders & approval path
- NovaHealth: Elena Soto (PM, pilot owner) — product validation; Carlos Mejia (InfoSec) — compliance signoff; CIO exec review (tentative) — final go/no-go.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — primary SE contact; Ben Carter — commercial lead; Jasmine Liu — solutions architect.

Milestones and dates (draft)
1) Pilot kickoff (integration readiness) — target 2027-08-16 — owner: Elena (NovaHealth) / Jasmine (Redwood)
2) Compliance checklist & test vectors shared — 2027-08-20 — owner: Carlos (NovaHealth) / Marissa (Redwood)
3) First perf validation & internal exec readout — 2027-09-03 — owner: Elena / Ben for pricing discussion
4) Exec approval (CIO decision) — 2027-09-10 — owner: NovaHealth execs

Immediate asks (by EOD Fri 2027-08-06)
- Elena: confirm pilot app (internal slug or API endpoint) and point person for integration.
- Carlos: share top 5 security questions for the pilot that need explicit answers (or confirm SOC2 evidence will be sufficient).
- NovaHealth: confirm acceptance of the draft milestones above or propose changes.

Attachments: NovaHealth_MPA_v1.pdf (one-pager with milestones and acceptance criteria); SOC2-evidence-summary.zip (summary of SOC2 artifacts we can share).

If this aligns, I’ll send an updated MPA with versioning and a short SOW stub for the pilot pricing cap.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap: pilot scope, compliance asks, and exec signoff path

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear note. Quick confirmation from our side:

- Pilot app: 'PatientAssist-v2' (API: api.nova/patientassist/v2) — internal lead is Priya Anand (cc’d on separate calendar invite).
- Security: Carlos will send the five priority questions by Thursday. SOC2 artifacts are helpful but we need a short statement on data-in-transit encryption and key handling for the VPC deployment.
- Dates: the proposed milestone dates look fine; CIO prefers the exec readout the week of 2027-09-06 (flexible).

Two items to flag:
1) We will need a demo checklist for the first readout (can you provide a short script of what you’ll show?).
2) Cost cap: for the first 90 days, we need a $10k hard cap for Redwood's hosted tokens usage or a defined throttling policy.

We’ll review the attached MPA and follow up with minor comments. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Elena
Elena Soto
Senior Product Manager, NovaHealth
elena.soto@novahealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@novahealth.com>, Carlos Mejia <carlos.mejia@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap: pilot scope, compliance asks, and exec signoff path

Elena — perfect, thanks for the quick confirmations. A few follow-ups and commitments from our side: 

- Demo script: attached in MPA_v1 appendix (one slide) — we’ll validate the 3 test prompts, show raw latency numbers, and demonstrate the redaction-in-flight flow.
- Cost cap options: we can support either a $10k hard cap (Redwood-hosted with token accounting) OR a throttling policy with alerting once 80% of the cap is reached. If you prefer the hard cap, we’ll attach a short SOW addendum.
- Encryption/key handling: for the private deployment path, Redwood uses TLS1.3 for in-transit and supports customer-managed keys via KMS; I attached the SOC2 evidence summary and a two-paragraph key handling note in the MPA.

Attached: NovaHealth_MPA_v1.pdf (updated with the demo script and KMS note) and SOC2-evidence-summary.zip.

Planned next steps (internal owners summarized)
- Marissa (Redwood): finalize SOW addendum for the $10k cap by 2027-08-06 if you choose hard cap.
- Jasmine (Redwood): schedule integration kickoff for 2027-08-16 and share quickstart repo.
- Carlos (NovaHealth): security Q&A by 2027-08-06.

> On Wed, 04 Aug 2027 09:14:00 +0000 Elena Soto wrote:
> > Pilot app: 'PatientAssist-v2' (API: api.nova/patientassist/v2) — internal lead is Priya Anand.
> > Security: Carlos will send the five priority questions by Thursday.
>
Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal with milestones (DL-2027-0419).

Best,
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 19:10:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Quick recap: pilot scope, compliance asks, and exec signoff path

Marissa — quick internal note. Good alignment on scope and cap. Two asks before I loop in Sales Ops for the SOW:
1) Confirm that the $10k cap includes any support hours or whether support will be billed separately (I recommend we include up to 4 hours of onboarding support in the cap to simplify contracting).
2) Can you add a one-line exec summary for the CIO readout that clearly states the expected business outcome (e.g., "reduce average triage latency to <600ms for goal flows; improved patient self-serve rate by ~12% on pilot signals")?

If you can drop those into the SOW addendum I’ll prep the pricing approval and internal signoff so we can meet the 2027-09-06 readout window.

— Ben
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
